verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one docs line saying Elasticsearch combines search with structured filters and aggregations in one engine. Aggregations are the basis for facets, but the pack never shows facet counts, range or attribute buckets, or returning hits and facets from a single query. Missing for 10: documentation of terms/range aggregations producing live facet counts, evidence that results and facets come back in one request, multi-select/attribute facet handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
